title: welcome sign with seasonal changes
text: welcome sign with seasonal changes. The basic sign is wood.. very crudely finished and the jute (or like) rope/string is attached a with a couple of staples.  There is a hook installed in the "o" of the welcome word.  There are a number of changeable seasonal painted pieces.  The front of each seasonal piece is painted, the back is painted white.  They are very lightweight and thinly painted. The heart piece has a bit of extra chain links that cause the piece to dangle a bit more - cute. The paint colors are bright - some I like more than others - but there are choices - so that's fun.  The pieces I received were exactly what is photographed and shown in the ad.  I did have to use some pliers to open the hook on the board a little as the seasonal hanging pieces wouldn't fit onto the hook.  I also added some felt pieces on the back of the welcome board so that it wouldn't scratch the door and/or be extra noisy.  It comes in a box that could be "giftable" but the pieces were all loose and tossed about in the box - which it is a bit of a bummer because they are so thinly painted, they could have been scratched and ruined.  In addition to the felt dots for the back, I did invest in an additional zippered bag to safely store the pieces not in use.  All in all it's ok - but maybe a bit expensive for the quality - but that's a personal opinion. And then you need the felt dots and a safe storage bag or such to store the pieces.  I purchased this for my 81 year old Mom's apartment door at an adult living center.  She will love to change the seasonal pieces.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
